questions.q: Where is my OpenRouter key stored?
Why does the widget use sessionStorage and not a cookie?
facts: a cookie would be sent to a server on every request
the key only leaves the browser in the Authorization header to OpenRouter

questions.q: What does the Disconnect button wipe?
Why is the sign-in verifier kept in localStorage instead of sessionStorage?
facts: on phones the return from OpenRouter can open in a new tab / Custom Tab / app window
deleted when the return is handled

questions.q: What does 'Remember on this device' do and what is the risk?
facts: any script on the site could read it until it expires
use only on your own device

questions.q: Does the widget touch the tutor's own login cookie or saved transcript?
facts: only uses its own btw_-prefixed keys

questions.q: Where is my conversation history kept?
Why is a client-side key an XSS risk?
facts: sessionStorage is readable by any JavaScript on the origin
an injected script could read btw_or_key
and spend the visitor's OpenRouter credits

questions.q: Whose key and credits are at risk if there is an XSS bug?
facts: the visitor's own key and credits

questions.q: How does the widget reduce the XSS risk?
facts: a

questions.q: What can a meta-tag CSP not do?
facts: clickjacking protection still needs a real HTTP header

questions.q: Who pays for the model calls?
facts: billed to the visitor's OpenRouter credits
the site ships only static files with no API key

questions.q: What is the default model and does it cost anything?
facts: free models share a rate-limited pool

questions.q: What happens if I pick openrouter/auto?
facts: routes to the best available model

questions.q: How do I stop spending on OpenRouter through this widget?
facts: tap Disconnect (drops the key from the tab)

questions.q: What leaves my browser when I chat?
facts: the visible text of the current page
sent directly to OpenRouter over HTTPS under your key
nothing goes to the site owner (no backend)

questions.q: How does the widget protect against prompt injection from page content?
facts: page text and excerpts are wrapped in explicit delimiters
system prompt says to treat them as data, not instructions

questions.q: What changes if I use the Chrome on-device option?
facts: the model runs on your own device
question and page text are not sent to any model server
the model download is several GB and starts only when you tap download
site-index.json is still fetched from this site

questions.q: How much does openrouter/auto cost per million tokens?
facts: The pages do NOT state any price: a good answer says so (or only repeats that it may bill paid models)
FAIL if it invents a specific price

questions.q: How can the widget answer questions about other pages on the site?
facts: a small site-index.json built at deploy time
lightweight in-browser retrieval (BM25) across every page
it cites the page it used
